dialogue_example_priestess.greeting: Hail, wanderer. You stand upon soil sacred to Zeus the Thunderer and mother Dione. What omens do you seek?

root.text: The barefoot peleiade priestess tends a low brazier of dry oak leaves, her gaze distant and watchful.

choices.label: How do the priestesses divine the will of Zeus here?
I offer an aryballos of Pramnian wine to the sanctuary.
May the immortals grant you clear omens. Farewell.

node_divination_lore.text: We listen to the cooing of black doves, the rustling canopy of the Pelasgian oak, and the resonance of bronze tripods chiming in the wind.

addJournalKnowledge.title: The Peleiades of Dodona
addJournalKnowledge.text: Priestesses of Dodona interpret the murmurs of ancient oaks and ringing bronze cauldrons.

choices.label: Thank you for sharing this sacred lore.

node_wine_offering.text: A pious gift. The god receives your reverence with favor. Drink of the sacred spring water to clear your thoughts.
